articles.summary: This Women’s History Month, we’re shining a light on three leaders across Winnebago Industries who share a commonality in how they lead. In very different roles, Julie Schepers, Krista Ragaini and Laura Fletty each believe that showing up authentically is essential to strengthening teams and creating experiences that elevate every moment outdoors.
articles.title: Leading from the inside out: Three women leaders at Winnebago Industries share on the importance of authentic impact

articles.summary: At Barletta Boats, integrity leads, people come first, and the experience matters just as much as the product itself. It’s a promise to stand behind every detail and support every dealer, team member and owner with transparency, respect and pride.
articles.title: More than a boat: How the Barletta marketing team emphasizes the experience
